import pathlib,subprocess,json,zlib,base64
repo=pathlib.Path('/home/qq/work/chain-cell-native-shard-674c72-20261110')
subprocess.run(['bash','scripts/project-preflight.sh'],cwd=repo,check=True)
data=json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode('')))
plan=repo/'docs/development/TRNM_AI_NATIVE_BLOCKCHAIN_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md'
original=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:'+str(plan.relative_to(repo))],cwd=repo)
assert plan.read_bytes()==original, 'preserve concurrent plan edits'
with (repo/'docs/development/specs/pon/CELL_NATIVE_SHARD_RESEARCH_V2.md').open('x') as f: f.write(data['doc'])
plan.write_text(data['prefix']+'\n'+original.decode())
print('RESEARCH_CONTRACT_AND_PLAN_APPLIED',flush=True)
